sentences.text: This is second bail application filed under section 439 of the Cr.P.C in crime no.125/2021 under section 506, 342, 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(I), 376(2) (N) of IPC and 3,4,51,6 of POCSO Act registered at police station Chainpur District Khargone.
2. It is alleged that the applicant has committed rape with the minor girl.
The prosecutrix has supported the prosecution case in her court statement.
3. As per the scholar register, the date of birth of the applicant is 06.05.2007 and on the date of incident, she was only 15 years 2 months of age.
4. At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present application.
